outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes (assessed by Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development Index, 3rd edition)
cohort: The study included n=666 extremely preterm infants (n=328 female, n=338 male) from a large, multi-center cohort who were born between 24-0/7 and 27-6/7 weeks' gestation.
finding: The study found no relationship between prenatal magnesium sulfate exposure and neurodevelopmental outcomes, either overall or when analyzed by sex, after accounting for confounding.
